name: Precio Fishbone AB (publ)
summary: Precio Fishbone AB (publ) operates as a consulting and software development company in Sweden, rest of European Union, and internationally. The company offers web and system development, UX, and consulting services, as well as robotic process automation services. It also provides NGO Online, a SaaS solution for aid organization; Optimizely, which creates .NET solutions for CMS, e-commerce, and digital marketing; UiPath that enhances business processes through the automation of repetitive and time-consuming tasks; and EVF, a passenger compensation management system. In addition, the company offers Microsoft 365, a comprehensive suite of productivity tools and services that includes Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint; and Copilot. It serves the public sector, service providers, non-profit organizations, and industries. The company was formerly known as Precio Systemutveckling AB (publ) and changed its name to Precio Fishbone AB (publ) in July 2015. Precio Fishbone AB (publ) was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Örebro, Sweden.
